newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal govt to sell 10 pct steel firm SN-Longos.
newsitem.headline: Portugal govt to sell 10 pct steel firm SN-Longos.

text.p: The Portuguese government will sell its remaining 10 percent stake in steel company Siderurgia Nacional-Empresa de Produtos Longos (SN-Longos) in a Public Offer to Sell (OPV) on the Lisbon bourse on August 4, according to a public announcement published in local media.

The state will sell off 10 percent of the capital of SN-Longos, or one million shares, at 400 escudos per share. Employees will be entitled to 500,000 shares and small investors and emigrants the remaining 500,000.
The seller of the shares is Siderurgia Nacional-Empresa de Servicos, held by the state.
Buy orders should be delivered to Lisbon bourse between July 23 and August 1.
